modern: Have you seen those things? Look at these too. Do not disturb yourself. Make yourself all simplicity. Does anyone do wrong? It is to himself that he does the wrong. Has anything happened to you? Well; out of the universe, from the beginning, everything that happens has been allotted and spun out for you. In a word, your life is short. You must make the most of the present with the help of reason and justice. Be sober in your relaxation.
original: Hast thou seen those things? Look also at these. Do not disturb thyself. Make thyself all simplicity. Does any one do wrong? It is to himself that he does the wrong. explained.summary:
A string of quick reminders. Don’t get worked up; keep things simple. If someone does wrong, they mainly harm themselves. Whatever happens to you was woven into the universe’s pattern from the start. Life is short, so make the most of the present with good sense and fairness.

The last line is a warning: even when you relax, stay sober and in control of yourself.
explained.today: When a friend lets you down, the damage is mostly to their own character, not yours. And the evening off is a chance to rest, not to drink or binge until you’ve lost the next morning.
